run.title: DA RUN BOX
body: PRESS WIN+R, OR CLICK RUN... IN DA START MENU, AN' TYPE DA NAME OF A PROGRAM: CALC, NOTEPAD, CHARMAP, REGEDIT, MSCONFIG, CMD, CONTROL, WINVER, CLEANMGR, DEFRAG, SYSDM.CPL, TIMEDATE.CPL, INTL.CPL, MMSYS.CPL, APPWIZ.CPL, DESK.CPL, DEVMGMT.MSC, EVENTVWR, OSK, WSCUI.CPL!

keys.title: KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS
body: ALT+TAB SWITCHES WINDOWS. ALT+F4 CLOSES DA ACTIVE ONE, OR TURNS DA MACHINE OFF WHEN NONE IZ OPEN!
CTRL+ESC OPENS DA START MENU. CTRL+SHIFT+ESC AN' CTRL+ALT+DEL OPEN DA TASK MANAGER!
WIN+D SHOWS DA DESKTOP, WIN+M MINIMIZES EVERYTHIN', WIN+E OPENS ME COMPUTER, WIN+F SEARCHES, WIN+L LOCKS, WIN+PAUSE OPENS SYSTEM PROPERTIES!
F1 OPENS DIS WINDOW, F3 DA SEARCH COMPANION, PRINTSCREEN COPIES DA SCREEN TA DA CLIPBOOK!

hardware.title: DA MACHINE YOU IZ SITTIN' AT
body: WHEN DA HYPERDECK BOOTS DA DESKTOP, DA PARTS FITTED TA ITS BOARD IZ DA HARDWARE: MEMORY, PROCESSOR, ADAPTER, DISK, MODEM AN' SOUND CARD IZ READ OFF DA DECK, AN' SYSTEM PROPERTIES, DEVICE MANAGER AN' DA CONTROL PANEL ALL AGREE!
REACHED FROM ANYWHERE ELSE, DA DESKTOP RUNS ON A STOCK MACHINE OF 2001, ROLLED ONCE PER WORLD AN' KEPT!
